required_fixes: Restore prereg sample size N=160 per endpoint (480 total): run_efficient.py currently uses N_SAMPLES_PER_ENDPOINT=20 (60 total) which is 12.5% of prereg. At n=60 SE=0.1325 CI width ~0.51, underpowered even if variance existed; prereg adequacy requires >=480 and spec estimated_cost 600 requests. Increase samples or justify power analysis for delta=0.15.

Select real API endpoints with natural stochastic variation in both behavioral and structural signals: current endpoints (GitHub api.github.com/repos/octocat/Hello-World, /users/octocat, jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts/1) return deterministic identical JSON (jaccard 1.0, schema_diff 0.0) and constant status codes (200 vs 403) yielding zero variance in behavioral_delta and structural_composite across all 60 samples. Use APIs with timestamps/request-IDs/dynamic content and rate-limit or auth state that varies within experiment window, or construct production-like test server with CDN simulation as suggested in report.md section 8.

Handle GitHub rate limiting to achieve usable success rate: unauthenticated GitHub quota 60/hr causes 100% 403 on all 40 GitHub paired samples, preventing status/body variation and blocking HTTP caching test. Use authenticated requests (PAT) or choose higher-quota endpoints (httpbin, postman-echo, or self-hosted Flask with OAuth middleware) to obtain >=80% 2xx success as required by spec C5_network_availability and falsifier C5 threshold.

Restore HTTP caching manipulation: all 60 samples have has_etag=false and responded_304=false. Spec measurement_validity requires If-None-Match/ETag where supported (GitHub supports ETags but none observed due to 403) and prereg C5 check expected 304. Choose ETag-supporting endpoints or inject cacheable resource with ETag-SHA256 as in parent mock_server.py, else mark C5 sub-condition explicitly BLOCKED.

Implement missing frozen baselines: spec baselines B-RANDOM-NULL (1000 permutations r~=0) and B-MOCK-ANTI-NULL (artificially coupled |r|>>0.15) and measurement_validity permutation bootstrap were not executed. Add them to demonstrate measurement sensitivity as required by prereg sections 9.3-10 and spec baselines.

Fix C1_behavioral_detection validity: current auth_detection_rate=1.0 counts only invalid Bearer token 401 response (40/40), never tests valid token, and behavioral_delta variance is 0.0 so no auth-boundary shift in composite. Prereg 9.1 requires variance >0 when probing valid vs invalid auth with Wilson lower >0.75 on detection rate. Test both valid and invalid states or measure behavioral composite difference directly.

Align status/outcome with frozen decision_rule verdict_mapping: spec maps C1_OR_C2_OR_C4_FAIL => MEASUREMENT_INVALID and C3_FAIL_CI_UPPER_GTE_020 => FALSIFIES. Producer result.json uses status=COMPLETE outcome=INCONCLUSIVE with C2 FAIL and C3 FAIL. Correct to status=MEASUREMENT_INVALID and explicitly map C2/C3 failure per spec to avoid misclassifying measurement ceiling as negative result.

Adjust timing parameters to match prereg: prereg 2.3 requires 1-2s between requests and 15s timeout; run_efficient.py uses RATE_LIMIT_DELAY=0.5s and REQUEST_TIMEOUT=10s. Align or document deviation impact on rate-limit detection and timeout missing-data handling.
validity_findings: C2_variance FAIL independently confirmed: 0/3 endpoints have std>0 for either signal. Recomputed from raw_evidence/experiment_data.json (n=60): behavioral_delta stdev=0.0 pooled and 0.0 per-endpoint (github_repos 20, github_users 20, jsonplaceholder 20), structural_composite stdev=0.0 pooled and per-endpoint. Behavioral composite baseline/current are constant per endpoint (GitHub 6.0/6.0, JSONPlaceholder 0.0/0.0), jaccard=1.0 schema_diff=0.0 for all 60. Meets spec falsifier OR behavioral detection fails but due to environment ceiling, not hypothesis.

C3_equivalence FAIL confirmed but mathematically undefined: pooled Pearson r is 0/0 (both signals constant). Producer reports r=0.0 CI [0.0,1.0] upper=1.0 tost_pass=false via pearson_r fallback (den_x==0 or den_y==0 => r=0 CI 0,1). Recomputation matches: recomputed_metrics pooled r=0 CI [0,1] upper 1.0. CI upper 1.0 >=0.15 (and >=0.20) would falsify per mapping if taken literally, but is uninformative. Correct interpretation per result.json validity_notes: CI is uninformative, does not support or falsify orthogonality.

C1_behavioral_detection PASS reported (auth_detection_rate=1.0) is vacuous: auth_status 401 on 40/40 GitHub probes confirms probe logic works (report.md 3.2), but behavioral_delta used for correlation has zero variance (mean 0.0) so auth challenge never couples to behavioral composite variation. Wilson lower CI not computed. Positive control validates network path, not signal variance. Downgrade to inconclusive — passes transport but fails to demonstrate discriminating behavioral signal variance.

C4_null_control PASS (FP 0.0 on 0/60 with behavioral_delta>0.5) is vacuous: with delta identically 0.0, FP=0 by construction. Recomputed fp_count=0 fp_rate=0.0. Control is mathematically forced when variance=0, not evidence of no false detection. Null control degeneracy matches determinism_check pattern in prior physics audits.

C5_network_availability PASS reported (3/3 reachable, network_errors=0) is technically correct at transport layer but API-level failure systematic: github_repos 20/20 403, github_users 20/20 403, jsonplaceholder 20/20 200. Falsifier condition 'network unavailability prevents measurement on >=2/3 endpoints' not triggered per transport, but 'real API variation could express effect' fails: 2/3 endpoints are rate-limited with no body/header variation, 1/3 is deterministic mock. Environment ceiling per instruction to test whether observed environment could express effect: CANNOT. This is infrastructure choice failure, not transient network failure, so BLOCKED not warranted but MEASUREMENT_INVALID is正确的 per spec C1_OR_C2_OR_C4_FAIL.

Sampling integrity violation: prereg 6.1/13 requires N_SAMPLES=160 per endpoint (480 total) and adequacy rule >=480. Provenance total_samples_collected 60 target 480. run_efficient.py:30 N_SAMPLES_PER_ENDPOINT=20 is 87.5% short. At n=60 Fisher SE=0.1325 vs parent SE 0.0457, minimum detectable |r| ~0.26 at 95% vs 0.09 at n=480. Even if variance existed, experiment would be severely underpowered for TOST at delta=0.15. GitHub rate limit (60/hr unauth) mirrors second validity_notes limitation.

Representation loss disclosed accurately by producer but not mitigated: spec measurement_validity requires behavioral from headers/status (rate_limit_remaining<10, auth 401/403, cache_freshness 304, status_class_score) and structural from JSON schema (Jaccard/schema_diff). All 60 have has_etag false, responded_304 false, rate_limit_det 0, cache_fresh 0, so behavioral_composite static; structural fields extracted correctly (extract_field_types) but identical. Producer validity_notes 6 items correctly identify endpoint suitability failure. No hidden leakage; error is omission of stochastic variation, not confound.

Spec expected these but no artifact. This weakens claim that measurement CAN detect correlation when present, though positive control on localhost parent (r=0.0022) already demonstrated sensitivity.

claim_ceiling: C-FRESHNESS behavioral-structural orthogonality at delta=0.15 remains confirmed ONLY under localhost stochastic Flask 3.1.3 + SQLite WAL-mode + in-memory TTL 0.5s + jitter 1-5ms + HS256/RS256 JWT + HTTP caching (Cache-Control max-age=5/no-store, ETag-SHA256, If-None-Match->304 at 33.3%) at n=480 (EXP-GRAPH-35389145821 pooled r=0.0022 CI [-0.087,0.092] upper 0.092<0.15). This experiment (EXP-GRAPH-35409927045, n=60, r undefined CI [0,1]) provides NO extension to real external APIs with production databases, distributed caches/CDN, network latency, OAuth/OIDC or stochastic SPA frontends. Maximum justified claim from this packet is MEASUREMENT_INVALID for real-API orthogonality: the tested stable public endpoints (GitHub unauth 403, JSONPlaceholder deterministic 200) have zero behavioral and structural variance and cannot express the effect, so orthogonality is untested, not falsified. No product promotion to VALIDATED or PRODUCT_CORE warranted from this evidence; claim status remains EXPERIMENTAL bounded to mock.
